body.statement: Can \(\mathsf{Handle}\) be turned into a deterministic rational certificate generator and independently implemented checker such that acceptance proves global optimality, every three-cell instance with at most five candidate arms agrees exactly with exhaustive enumeration, and nontrivial structural conditions on the action-score cost tensor guarantee a certificate of size polynomial in \(|\mathcal C|+|\mathcal F|+|\mathcal X|\)?
body.justification: The exhaustive checker is settled infrastructure but may be exponential; the open content is whether the causal action-score structure yields compact proof objects on meaningful subclasses.
body.gap: AnthonyGoyalGuptaNagarajan2010 gives logarithmic approximation for robust \(k\)-median, and generic VIPR work gives exact proof logs; neither supplies compact exact certificates for this causal tensor.
body.consumer: The result would let clinical trial planners archive compact, durable evidence that a chosen multi-model panel is exactly optimal.
